summary: The proof is complete and the stated constants are correct. Positive reservoir load forces positive endpoint volumes and hence positive root masses. Convexity of the positive-root metronoid set gives exactly theta_e = 2^{-(d+1)}(a_u^{1/d}+a_v^{1/d})^d, and AM-GM gives theta_e >= sqrt(a_u a_v)/2. For a fixed color and target, each unordered reflected edge contributes twice to the ordered reflection sum, reflection is a parity-preserving bijection, and Cauchy-Schwarz gives the exact quarter-congestion bound. The common cross-color scaling preserves the pooled barycenter and produces an admissible density of mass chi_m alpha_m. Metronoid depth then yields the claimed halfspace domination, residual-selector bound, dominated-measure bound, and individual-target bound with the factors gamma_d 2^{n-rho_J} and gamma_d 2^n. In the canonical hard branch, alpha_m = Omega_m and widehat alpha = widehat Omega; nonnegativity of the terms in A(C), together with Omega >= Q-R, yields every strict 1/100 and 99/100 constant in (28)-(29). Empty color-target cells contribute zero, all divisions occur only for positive cells or edges, the residual ranks are invoked only when widehat E is nonempty, and the hard branch forces Q>0 and Omega>0, so the zero-reservoir and empty-support cases create no unsupported conclusion.
